events.text: Join Fr Peter Koh, CICM, for a Mandarin retreat on Fri, 9 Nov (public holiday), 9am–5pm, in the Parish Hall, exploring Creating Christ Encounters – Many Parts, One Body. Lunch and tea are provided. Fee: $10 at the door. Register with Simon at 96628873.

adoration.text: Daily after first Mass until 22:00. Closed for cleaning Saturdays 09:45–11:45. Divine Mercy Holy Hour Tuesdays 19:15; parish intercessory prayers first Thursday 20:00 (every Thursday during Lent).

confession.text: 30 minutes before Sunday and Saturday Sunset Masses; excludes Saturday 07:00 Mass.

devotions.text: Weekday Rosary at 17:40 in Church, except public holidays; all welcome without registration. Heading says weekday although body says daily.

office_hours.text: Monday–Friday 09:30–18:30; Saturday 09:30–19:30; Sunday 07:30–19:30; closed public holidays.

good_to_know.text: Galerie Sainte Bernadette new hours from October 2026: Wednesday 16:00–18:00; Saturday 10:00–12:00 and 15:30–17:30; Sunday 09:00–13:00 and 15:00–17:00. Visit page still gives Tuesday/Thursday; announcement supersedes it.
Parish Centre Level 1: Media Centre/bookshop Saturday 17:00–19:30, Sunday 08:30–13:00. Canteen Sunday 08:30–12:00, closed New Year, Chinese New Year, Easter and Christmas.
Thrift Shop, Annexe Level 1: patio Thursday 10:30–15:00, Saturday 09:00–16:00 and last Sunday 09:00–13:00; main shop Saturday 13:00–16:00 and last Sunday 10:00–13:00.

getting_there.text: Limited parking; public transport recommended. Great World MRT TE15 Exits 2/6 through mall to Zion Road near PS Café, about 400m/six-minute walk. Bus stop B13121 Opp Great World City one minute away; buses 75, 970, 16, 175, 195 listed.

sacraments.text: For children younger than seven. Next published date 8 November 2026; applications close 15th of preceding month. Mandatory parents/godparents briefing Sunday 15:00 one week before baptism. Submit form, child birth certificate, parents’ marriage certificate, Catholic parent baptism certificate and godparents’ confirmation certificates. Godparents at least 16, fully initiated/practising, Catholic-married if married.
Contact parish at least 12 months ahead; all couples take MPC, Catholic Engaged Encounter or approved Couple Mentor Journey.
Contact parish for anointing, Eucharist for the sick, Viaticum and reconciliation; page encourages arranging while person can still pray with priest.
Office coordinates funeral and Prayer @ Wake ministry. No wake parlour on church grounds.
Youth: four-year programme from Level 7 to Level 10 (around 16). Adults 18+ may prepare through RCIA.

Flexible staged journey for adults 18+; introduction generally first Wednesday, subject to signups and confirmation. Published 7 October and 4 November 2026 at 19:45 in Conference Room above parish office; FAQ instead says 20:00, confirm. Sponsors also welcome.

other.text: Parish FORMED subscription available to parishioners: sign up as parishioner using postal code 247731. No account created during collection.
